text:
maria.g: quick q — I'm preparing a TF change to add a ServiceAccount for the external secret controller in tenant-apps-prod. plan is to set the namespace annotation 'secret-controller/enabled: \"true\"' and add a sa 'es-controller' with IRSA annotation. anyone see a gating concern before I open the PR?

ben.s: quick read — which controller binary/version are we targeting? newest external-secrets changed how it reads namespace annotations (v0.6+). if you're on older image this won't work. also need to ensure the controller pod's SA has permission to list Secrets in that namespace.

maria.g: we're on external-secrets:v0.7.2 per helm values in the repo. terraform will create aws_iam_role for the SA and put the annotation 'eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/es-controller-tenant-prod' on the SA. sample TF snippet I'm planning to apply:

```hcl
resource "kubernetes_service_account" "es_controller" {
  metadata {
    name      = "es-controller"
    namespace = "tenant-apps-prod"
    annotations = {
      "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = aws_iam_role.es_role.arn
      "secret-controller/enabled"  = "true"
    }
  }
}
```

ben.s: looks OK. two quick checks: 1) make sure aws_iam_role has the trust policy for OIDC provider for that cluster and namespace SA. 2) confirm any existing SA with same name won't be overwritten in a way that removes other annotations. run `kubectl get sa es-controller -n tenant-apps-prod -o yaml` first. if it exists, we'll patch instead of replace.

cory.ops-bot: FYI: Automation note — applying TF plan to this namespace will trigger the deploy pipeline that runs the secret-sync reconciliation job. If you want to avoid a cascade to prod secrets, flip the feature flag in values.yaml `syncOnCreate: false` then canary.

maria.g: good call. I'll flip syncOnCreate=false in the chart override and run a canary in tenant-apps-staging first.

samantha: also add an RBAC check in PR: clusterrolebinding for the controller should include verbs [get,list,watch,create,update,patch] on secrets. infra-qa will run a quick dry-run.

infra-qa: running preflight: namespaced-svcacct-check against tenant-apps-staging. Will report back with any missing rolebindings or conflicting annotations. expected runtime ~15m.

ben.s: one more thought — token projection TTL. If the controller relies on projected tokens for AWS creds, ensure sa tokenProjection duration matches kubelet default or set `serviceAccountTokenExpirationSeconds` in API server for the cluster. Otherwise you might see auth flakes after rotation.

maria.g: noted. I'll add a note in the PR checklist and include the kubectl output + TF plan. thanks all :thumbsup:
